## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Frankston East, Australia. It starts at 550 Tyabb-Tooradin Road.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Visit Moonlit Sanctuary in the Mornington Peninsula, also known as Pearcedale Conservation Park. This sanctuary is home to Australia's rare and cute animals.
>
> Get close to koalas, kangaroos, dingoes, wombats, and a variety of birds. These animals live in harmony, promoting eco-tourism. The sanctuary is perfect for children and wildlife enthusiasts of all ages.
>
> Located just an hour from Melbourne CBD, Moonlit Sanctuary offers both day and night experiences with Australia's beloved animals in a lush setting.
